name: Secure Boot
description: Windows MDM settings in the Secure Boot category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Configure High Confidence Opt Out
properties.description: This policy provides permission to opt out of high confidence buckets that will automatically be applied as part of the LCU.

enum.description: (Enabled) Opt out of high confidence buckets that will automatically be applied as part of the LCU

properties.name: Configure Microsoft Update Managed Opt In
properties.description: This policy controls provides permission to opt-in to CFR servicing (Microsoft Managed)

properties.name: Enable Secureboot Certificate Updates
properties.description: This policy enables the Secure Boot certificate update process. Setting this to Enabled causes the new Secure Boot certificates to be installed and installs the 2023 signed boot manager for all devices where the policy is applied.

enum.description: (Enabled) Initiates the deployment of new Secure Boot certificates and related updates
